searchText: Hey all! I totally get that Witti isn't functional yet, but I wanted to know how volatile the instructions for each client are. I'm writing a guide for someone, and I'd like to include Witti instructions for Prysm with it. So I'm specifically asking about the instructions on https://github.com/goerli/schlesi/tree/master/prysm
